name: smwgraphics-super-adventure-island-stage-1
title: Super Adventure Island - Stage 1-2 (Forest)
description:
Here are the foreground graphics from the forest level on Super Adventure Island for the SNES. (The second level of the game.) It includes all the tiles in the level for the most part except all the waterfall graphics.


Comes with three ExGFX files which includes the waterfall animation and uses palette rows 2-5 and uses a little bit of row 7.
